text:
Keep Paper & Pencil Nearby
A cozy little habit that helps every lesson stick.

We warmly suggest keeping some paper and a pencil next to you while you learn. Jotting down new words, phrases, and grammar patterns by hand helps connect what you hear with what you speak.
Your notes don’t need to be neat—quick scribbles and little doodles work wonders for your memory!
